_comment: Shrink-only ratchets for the Podcast Factory Library. Numbers here are a
RECORD of today's debt, not a target: each may fall and none may rise.
Enforced by scripts/check-frontend-ratchets.mjs (npm run ratchets).
After genuinely improving a number: npm run ratchets:update, which refuses to
record a regression.
Same shape as plan-dashboard/frontend-ratchets.json, adapted rather than
shared — this app imports nothing from plan-dashboard/ at runtime, and that
boundary holds for dev tooling too. Added 2026-08-16, closing the gap the
repo audit recorded as CQ-NO-LINT / CQ-NO-SIZE-GATE: this app had no lint
config and no size gate at all.
lintWarnings is per RULE, not one total, so a new `any` cannot hide behind
someone else's fixed hook warning and still read as progress.
fileSize: every file is governed by exactly ONE rule. A file at or under the
ceiling is governed by the ceiling; a file above it is governed by its own
recorded pin, which it may fall below and may never exceed. 850 chosen from
this app's own distribution (107 sized files, median 148, p95 795) — same
reasoning as plan-dashboard's ceiling, scaled to this app's actual shape: the
four top outliers (three UI routes plus the player, 1162-1399 lines) sit
clear of everything else, and the next file down (access.server.ts, 807)
sits inside a dense cluster with admin.usage.tsx (795) and marks.server.ts
(772) rather than as a fifth outlier — so 850 grandfathers only the genuine
break in the distribution instead of an arbitrary line through that cluster.
